assertions.description: A declared web app is served and every declared DOM probe passes; a failing probe is published, not dropped.
HTTP status 200 and the exact document byte length are reported as measured values.
The CSP header denies connections, objects and base URIs, and permits scripts only from 'self'.
Served bytes are identical to the declared files; encoded path traversal is refused with 403; non-GET methods are refused with 405.
The preview digest is stable and independent of key order, so a human preview can be proven to be the artefact the trial ran.
The software manifest names, by feature, what it cannot do: client-side JS, script execution, dependency installation and screenshots.
